parts.text: Find a time for a team lunch next week and suggest what we could eat.
A ranked shortlist of 2-4 time slots, each with how many of the team are free, a recommendation with a reason, and catering options drawn from the catering.menu_items table.
Friday 12:00-13:00 works. Book it with the Fiesta Taco Bar.
A confirmation that the meeting was booked for Friday 12:00-13:00 with Fiesta Taco Bar catering, quoting the booking id returned by book_meeting.
What lunches has the team already booked?
The bookings get_bookings returns, each with its time slot and catering, or a plain statement that nothing is booked. Bookings are team-wide, so the answer does not depend on who is asking.
Set up another team lunch. Check what is already booked first and do not reuse a slot we have taken.
A shortlist that excludes every slot get_bookings reports as taken, saying which were skipped and why.
The Friday booking resolved to an id via get_bookings and then cancelled, naming which meeting went. If more than one Friday booking exists it asks which, rather than guessing.
Cancel every lunch on the team calendar. Yes, all of them.
The current bookings listed and the exact number that will be cancelled stated before cancel_all_bookings is called, with expected_count set to that number.
A request for clarification. Nothing is cancelled: 'start over' is about the conversation, and the calendar is shared with the whole team.
